status: Mounted laminate and tail development; fabrication and physical qualification pending

body.unroll_reference: Each foil's active conductor center plane. This is a geometric cut/reference surface, not a measured mechanical neutral axis.
notes: Column copper faces outward toward the film; row copper faces inward toward the film.
Separate coverlay openings occupy the active region. Outside the opening, the two 0.05 mm facing coverlays nominally replace the 0.10 mm film gap.
Keep adhesive out of active film/copper interfaces. Edge retention, sealing and unloaded contact preload remain to be verified on the complete assembly.
The nail row foil retains backside feeds and static interlayer connections. Other foils have one conductor layer.
The 0.1 mm nail cover is a thin prototype process target. Wear, friction, low-force response and 20 N durability are not established.
The existing 8 mm straight witnesses do not fit across the 3 mm patch gaps. New narrow sections must be routed and resistance-checked.
Long sections widen after leaving the contact region; the earlier 1.5 mm conductor target is not automatically met by these routes.
Shorter stiffened ends are proposed to avoid the adjacent lower connector. Keep interlayer transitions inside a supported static region.
Provide bending slack between the moving TPU and fixed connector board. A straight taut strip is not accepted as a 3 mm motion solution.
The 3 mm motion is an integration assumption, not a predicted deflection at 20 N.

connector.note: Direct vendor downloads returned HTTP 403 in this workspace; the official 2D drawings remain visible through web review. The exact mating datum is still open, so no installed fit is claimed.
connector.candidate_revision: Rotate the three upper connector pairs 180 degrees so their tails leave toward the back of the board; move the test mux between upper tails. Preserve the published original fanout module.
